decks.notes: This deck revolves around utilizing Atraxa's abilities to control the game by manipulating the board state, countering threats, and gaining card advantage. The deck includes a variety of powerful control spells such as Counterspell, Cryptic Command, and Force of Will to disrupt opponents' plans. Additionally, the deck features versatile removal options like Abrupt Decay, Fatal Push, and Swords to Plowshares to deal with opposing threats efficiently. By combining efficient removal and counter spells with card advantage engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Sylvan Library, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can establish a dominant position and secure a win.

The deck revolves around aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of burn spells, cheap creatures, and token generation to quickly overwhelm and defeat the opponent. Cards like Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Burst Lightning provide direct damage to the opponent or key threats, while creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Kari Zev, Skyship Raider, and Legion Loyalist can deal damage quickly and efficiently. Token generators like Krenko's Command and Dragon Fodder help to build a board presence, while cards like Hellrider and Tempt with Vengeance can provide additional damage and pressure. The commander, Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph, synergizes well with the deck's aggressive strategy, allowing for repeated damage and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Grist, the Hunger Tide as the commander to create a highly aggressive aggro strategy. It includes a variety of creature-based cards such as Elves of Deep Shadow, Elvish Mystic, and Birds of Paradise to generate mana quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, cards like Birthing Pod and Fauna Shaman provide creature tutoring and toolbox options to adapt to different situations. The inclusion of cards like Dark Confidant and Sylvan Library provides card advantage, while cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Scavenging Ooze help disrupt graveyard strategies. Overall, the deck aims to swarm the board with creatures, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies, utilizing the partner commanders Bruse Tarl, Boorish Herder and Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck is packed with low-cost creatures like Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit and Isamaru, Hound of Konda, along with efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon can disrupt opponents' mana bases, giving you an edge in the game. Equipment such as Embercleave and Skullclamp enhance the creatures' abilities and provide additional value. With a fast and powerful mana base, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells, ultimately securing a quick victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through various means. The commander, Soul of Windgrace, provides card advantage and graveyard recursion, allowing for a resilient game plan. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, such as Abrupt Decay and Terminate, to deal with threats efficiently. It also utilizes board wipes like Anger of the Gods and Sweltering Suns to clear the field. The deck aims to ramp up its mana with cards like Exploration and Rampant Growth, enabling it to play powerful spells like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. Additionally, it features land-based synergies with cards like Titania's Command and Primeval Titan. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game state while gradually gaining advantage through land synergy and card advantage.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage, while using Elminster as the commander to dictate the pace of the game. By utilizing cards like Counterspell, Force of Will, and Cryptic Command, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor provide additional card advantage and control options. The deck also has versatile removal options such as Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict to deal with threats effectively. Overall, the strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and winning through incremental advantage and control.

The deck is focused on playing aggressively using a combination of low-cost creatures, direct damage spells, and sacrificing creatures for value. The key strategy revolves around putting pressure on the opponent early with fast creatures like Goblin Guide and Bloodghast, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning. This aggressive playstyle is further enhanced by cards like Falkenrath Aristocrat and Mayhem Devil that can deal additional damage when creatures are sacrificed. The deck also includes ways to recur creatures from the graveyard, such as Unearth and Woe Strider, to maintain a steady stream of threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing enchantments and synergies with the commander, Sythis, Harvest's Hand, to control the opponent's board and resources. By establishing a strong enchantress engine with cards like Enchantress's Presence and Eidolon of Blossoms, the deck aims to draw cards and generate mana advantage. The deck includes a variety of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Primordium to deal with threats efficiently. It also features land ramp spells like Exploration and Utopia Sprawl to accelerate its mana base and enable powerful plays earlier in the game. Overall, the key strategy revolves around establishing a resilient board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan through control elements and incremental advantages.
